title: Turn job planning on in athena.toml and record the decision
summary: Retry of job 5b: enable [job_plan] in athena.toml with the design's caps, and record the decision in docs/decisions.md. Per the user's reply, test-only edits are allowed in athena-cli's test helper, athena-data config tests and run_pin_tests so they strip the section; every test edit is noted in the design doc.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria run cargo test/clippy/fmt to check behavior.
Decision entry cites the design and gives measured baseline numbers.
Single focused config change plus record.
Criteria check tests actually pass with planning on.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: turn job planning on in this repo's config; audience is the owner and the verifier, who check the config parses and nothing regresses.
The user's reply to the earlier question takes precedence: test-only edits in config.rs and run_pin_tests.rs are allowed.
Planning stage code and config schema stay unchanged (out of scope per the original request).
Decision entry number follows the last in docs/decisions.md (earlier attempt used D110).

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml has a [job_plan] section with enabled = true, planner_usd = 0.75, critic_usd = 0.75, planner_timeout_s = 600, critic_timeout_s = 600, max_rounds = 3, and no unknown fields.

Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, including the repo-config test parsing athena.toml with planning on, crates/athena-cli/tests, run_pin_tests, the athena-data config tests, and xtask's boundary test.

Only test code changed under crates/: crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs, test code in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, and test code in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs. No non-test code (planning stage, config schema) changed. The producer's final output lists the changed files and confirms each is allowed.

Tests that need the unplanned path strip the [job_plan] section wherever it sits in athena.toml, sharing one stripping helper where crate boundaries allow. Tests appending their own [job_plan] (job_plan.rs, config.rs unknown-key and defaults tests) do not end up with the section twice.

docs/decisions.md has a new numbered entry turning planning on, citing docs/design/job-planning.md: alternatives from section 7; keep rule from section 9 (landed share of dispatched change jobs, baseline 64%, hold through 30 planned jobs unless it falls, decide at 100 jobs on 72% and a $2.50 cost ceiling per landed job); reversal (set enabled = false).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for turning job planning on naming athena.toml; the 'Built as' note in docs/design/job-planning.md mentions every test edit.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both pass.

out_of_scope: Changing the planning stage or the [job_plan] schema
